OnValidationFailure: Preserve bytes that fail provider digest, publisher checksum, declared archive content/member or Authenticode hash-integrity validation under a unique sibling name.
Record rejection time, product/version, source URI, rejection reason, SHA-256 and file size in the rejected artifact sidecar.
Move any prior canonical observation sidecar beside the rejected bytes instead of leaving it to describe a missing or different canonical file.
Free the canonical package/version/FileName path so the next acquisition downloads a fresh candidate.
Do not write success observations for rejected bytes.
Include the retained rejected-artifact path in the validation error when quarantine succeeds.
Implementation.SignaturePolicyBoundary: Authenticode HashMismatch remains a failure; other signature statuses are evidence rather than a universal install gate. License-review metadata is independent.
Implementation.Retention: Rejected bytes are preserved; no automatic cleanup policy is introduced.

KeyCases: Publisher checksum mismatch moves failed bytes away from the canonical path without recording success.
The next acquisition downloads and retains the publisher-matching bytes while the rejected bytes remain available.
A provider SHA-512 mismatch in an altered cached artifact removes it from the reusable canonical path.
Authenticode HashMismatch is retained as rejected bytes and never recorded as a successful acquisition.
Rejected artifact sidecars record the failure, and an old canonical observation is relocated.
